concept.concept: A classic trick-or-treat bag shape illustrated as the tote itself, with the text 'I'm the Candy Auditor' in chunky retro font.
concept.audience: Halloween superfans and candy lovers who celebrate the holiday with maximum enthusiasm, aged 22-40
concept.rationale: Meta-concept of a trick-or-treat tote that acknowledges itself is clever and shareable. 'Candy Auditor' is a fresh phrase that hasn't been done to death. Perfectly timed for the buying window. Strong gifting and self-purchase appeal.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I'm the Candy Auditor" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a classic orange canvas trick-or-treat tote bag centered on a solid cream background. The bag is depicted straight-on, simple geometric shape with two black handles at the top, rendered as bold solid color blocks with sharp edges. Add a small jack-o'-lantern face on the front in black, orange, and yellow solid colors. The bag has a subtle highlight stripe in a lighter orange to suggest dimension without gradients. No text on the bag itself. Generous margins around all edges. Screen-print aesthetic with high contrast. Limited palette: burnt orange, black, bright yellow, cream background. Readable from across a room at 12x16 inches. No photorealism, no gradients, no drop shadows.
design.style: Chunky retro serif font in solid black, arched above the tote bag illustration, bold and blocky letterforms with slight geometric character, maximum readability

verdict.reason: The phrase 'I'm the Candy Auditor' is an original, humorous Halloween expression with no known trademark conflicts. It does not reference any brand, character, celebrity, team, song lyric, or protected slogan. The design concept uses a generic trick-or-treat bag illustration, which is a common public domain visual motif. The chunky retro font style is a generic aesthetic choice. This combination presents minimal IP risk and is cleared for print-on-demand use.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly 'I'M THE CANDY AUDITOR' correctly spelled and complete. The illustration is a generic Halloween trick-or-treat bag with a jack-o-lantern icon — no IP risk, no quality issues, clean flat vector art suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Halloween Candy Tote Bag - I'm the Candy Auditor Retro Design
listing.description: For the ultimate Halloween enthusiast who takes candy inventory seriously. This tote features a classic trick-or-treat bag shape illustrated as the tote itself, with 'I'm the Candy Auditor' in chunky retro font that screams October fun. Perfect for carrying Halloween haul, party snacks, or everyday essentials with maximum seasonal spirit. The bold vintage aesthetic appeals to candy lovers and Halloween superfans who celebrate the holiday with enthusiasm and humor. Durable canvas tote ideal for trick-or-treating, Halloween parties, or year-round use. A fun gift for anyone who's passionate about the spooky season.
